author: ImTheRealBakugo
body:
Hi, I'm LythureIsBack and I'm again on LFT since I leave my past team (NewDawn) due to discrepancies with the team leader. 
I'm searching a team whith a good communication and in which people don't shout to speak each other. 
I'm good at midline, defender or helping with the bridge, also I can play as a support. And about my PvP skills I'm not bad with the sword but I'm better with the bow. I'm from Europe so I have bad ping, and that's all. 
Waiting for a new team.
